flows.title: Pick the mode a task belongs in
steps: Le Chat is now Vibe, and chat.mistral.ai is still the way in: your plan, history and settings came with it.
Choose Work for multi-stage professional tasks across your apps and tools — research, drafts, summaries, scheduled runs.
Choose Code for development work, in your terminal, in VS Code, or as remote cloud sessions.
Choose Chat for quick turn-based conversations and the features Le Chat had: Agents, Think mode, Code Interpreter and Memories. Deep Research moved to Work as a Skill.

flows.title: Hand a multi-step task to Work
steps: Open Vibe and select Work in the sidebar from the mode selector. If the sidebar is closed, click the drawer icon or press Cmd+Shift+B on a Mac, or Ctrl+Shift+B on Windows and Linux. Vibe reopens whichever tab you used last, so check the mode before starting.
Describe the outcome you want, and say what source material or tools it should use, who the output is for, and any constraints such as length, tone, format or a deadline.

Point it at context where it matters: connectors for approved external tools, Libraries for indexed document collections, Skills for a repeatable method, uploaded files and Canvas, or web search and Open URL for a specific page.
Follow the live todos panel on the right, answer follow-up questions, approve or deny the actions it asks about, and press the stop button — the black square — if it goes the wrong way.
Read the result as a draft: check facts, tables, dates, names and sources against the original before using or sharing it.
